title: Support ticket
idea: Support ticket: Case identity and current responsibility lead into a chronological record of updates, evidence and next actions.
audience: People who need to manage case within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: People need accountability across a long-running issue.
avoidWhen: A timeline would imply updates that were never delivered.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its manage case priority and explicit commitment contract: Distinguish a saved internal note from an externally sent reply.
navigation: Support ticket keeps the current manage case context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Case identity and current responsibility lead into a chronological record of updates, evidence and next actions.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to manage case; people need accountability across a long-running issue.
composition.priority: Distinguish a saved internal note from an externally sent reply.

imagery.role: Support the actual manage case context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep ownership and next action above a chronological compact record.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the support ticket structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no manage case content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Distinguish a saved internal note from an externally sent reply.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized manage case content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Distinguish a saved internal note from an externally sent reply.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active manage case context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
